title: Access to records by oversight coordinator and commission.
bodyText: The department of corrections and rehabilitation shall provide full access to all information requested by the oversight coordinator and commission.
bodyHtml: §353L-5  Access to records by oversight coordinator and commission.  The department of corrections and rehabilitation shall provide full access to all information requested by the oversight coordinator and commission. [L 2019, c 179, pt of §2; am L 2022, c 278, §29]
